basis: Both actual independent blind marker decisions, not a changed hidden pass rule. Bad point-allocation false passes remain reported as passes under the actual V1 rubric.

requiredCorrections: Protect numerical application of the signed momentum change by a loss greater than the 2-point slack. Currently general end-minus-start alone earns 1.5/3, allowing Se7168e62bd to pass at 8.5 without applying the momentum values. At unchanged 10/8, generic-only credit must be below 1/3. Preserve credit for exact numerical expressions and equivalent methods.

Protect application of the correct time interval. Currently a maintained incorrect duration can earn meanForce A=1.5, B=0.5 and C=0.5, allowing 8.5 overall with the other criteria complete. At unchanged 10/8, such interval evidence must earn below 2/4. Continue treating demonstrably isolated duration arithmetic slips under the global 0.5 rule.

Protect physical direction interpretation by more than 2 points. Its omission currently permits S2a75233472 to pass at 8; maintained incorrect sign interpretation can also pass. At unchanged 10/8, sign-only credit must be below 1/3 while an equivalent correct directed result retains full credit.

Increase the published deduction for an explicit unsupported constant-force or instantaneous-force inference to more than 2 points. The current 1.5 deduction permits both such misconceptions to pass at 8.5. Continue requiring no additional discussion when that false assertion is absent.

Apply revisions consistently to both languages and the shared marking notes. Retain a compliant 8–12-point total, a threshold no higher than 85%, room for one isolated 0.5-point slip, consistent follow-through and passing solely by the published total; introduce no extra veto.

Revise both language versions so that applying the signed momentum change to the data carries more than the 2-point pass margin. At the current 8/10 cutoff, award at most 0.5/3 for the general subtraction order alone. Keep full credit for a correct signed change or an exact numerical subtraction wherever it appears.

Protect use of the actual time interval. With the current A+B+C structure, award at most 0.5 for the quotient relation when the work never applies the correct duration, so that this relation, follow-through arithmetic and a force unit together earn at most 1.5/4. Keep the one-slip allowance for an isolated error after a visibly correct setup.

Give the physical direction interpretation more than 2 of the 3 direction points. For example, award 0.5 for the sign and 2.5 for interpreting it. A signed value alone and a maintained wrong interpretation must each fall below 8 overall. Keep full credit for an equivalent directed value and the 0.5 allowance for a demonstrably isolated label slip.

Increase the once-only interval deduction for explicitly inferring a constant force or a particular instantaneous force from the average to 2.5 points, floored at zero. Silence about instantaneous force should still earn full credit. Publish the changes in the scoring steps and shared marking notes, retaining a single points-based pass decision.
